bio: Meticulous and calculating, Stefano approaches each venture with the precision of a navigator plotting a course through treacherous waters. His years commanding ships instilled a disciplined patience that serves him well in his current enterprises—whether measuring ingredients for the perfect loaf or analyzing property investments in Cannaregio.
